scope.description: A context-specific direction for images where the user supplies words or symbols as part of the composition. It organizes those exact marks through hand-drawn emphasis, selective overlap, color grouping, and occasional strike-through when requested. It does not supply the words, symbols, cultural references, or message.
limitations: Apply only when the user explicitly supplies words or symbols for the image.
Preserve the exact supplied wording, spelling, symbol count, and requested legibility.
Cross out, circle, repeat, or obscure a mark only when the user requests that operation.
Add no crown, skull, anatomy diagram, signature, street tag, historical allusion, or political message unless explicitly requested.
Keep the requested main subject legible beneath mark and color layers.
Do not copy a named painting's layout, text, symbol, or figure arrangement.

rules.applies_when: The user supplies one or more words or symbols and requests them in the image.
rules.instruction: Preserve every supplied word and symbol exactly, then use only requested differences in size, color, placement, repetition, or surrounding marks to make a readable hierarchy; invent no additional text.
rules.observable: All requested text is present with the requested spelling and relative emphasis, and no unrequested text appears.
rules.reject_when: Words are substituted, duplicated without request, obscured beyond requested legibility, or mixed with invented labels.
rules.avoid: automatic tags, pseudo-writing, extra dates, signatures, and copied phrases

rules.applies_when: The user explicitly requests a word or symbol to be crossed out, circled, boxed, or partially covered.
rules.instruction: Apply the requested intervention only to the designated mark; make the intervention increase attention while retaining the degree of legibility the user requested.
rules.observable: The selected mark remains identifiable and the gesture clearly targets it rather than decorating the entire composition.
rules.reject_when: Unrequested text is crossed out, the target becomes unreadable against the request, or marks target other objects.
rules.avoid: random crossed words, illegible scribble fields, and generalized censorship motifs

rules.applies_when: The user requests a rough mixed-media or hand-marked surface.
rules.instruction: Layer a small number of hand-drawn marks and high-contrast color planes around the requested subject, then leave visible ground and quiet gaps so the mark hierarchy remains readable.
rules.observable: Line, color, and abrasion form distinct layers without replacing the subject or filling every area with noise.
rules.reject_when: The composition becomes an all-over graffiti wall, a clean corporate typography layout, or a generic distressed filter.
rules.avoid: uniform splatter, generic neon graffiti, and globally distressed texture

joint_checks.instruction: Build an expressive, hand-made hierarchy from the user's own words and symbols while keeping the requested subject, spelling, and mark operations intact.
joint_checks.observable: No invented words or iconography appear; requested interventions are localized; color and line form a hierarchy with visible open ground.

review.note: Successful compilation is not image-quality validation or a maturity upgrade.
